verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Again the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E VEIO a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמְּךָ֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֶ֕רֶץ כִּֽי־ אָבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ חָ֑רֶב וְלָקְח֨וּ עַם־ הָאָ֜רֶץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ מִקְצֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ לָהֶ֖ם לְצֹפֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê- ‘am·mə·ḵā wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ’e·reṣ kî- ’ā·ḇî ‘ā·le·hā ḥā·reḇ wə·lā·qə·ḥū ‘am- hā·’ā·reṣ ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ miq·ṣê·hem wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·ṯōw lā·hem lə·ṣō·p̄eh
verses.literal: Son of man speak to your people . . . and tell them Suppose I bring the sword against a land and the people of that land choose a man from among them appointing him as their watchman
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, fala aos filhos do teu povo, e dize-lhes: Quando eu fizer vir a espada sobre a terra, e o povo da terra tomar um homem dos seus termos, e o constituir por seu atalaia;

verses.original: וְרָאָ֥ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב בָּאָ֣ה עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְתָקַ֥ע בַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר וְהִזְהִ֥יר אֶת־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ bā·’āh ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ṯā·qa‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār wə·hiz·hîr ’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: and he sees the sword coming against that land and blows the ram’s horn to warn the people
verses.literalPt: E, vendo ele que a espada vem sobre a terra, tocar a trombeta e avisar o povo;

verses.original: וְשָׁמַ֨ע הַשֹּׁמֵ֜עַ אֶת־ ק֤וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר֙ וְלֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר וַתָּ֥בוֹא חֶ֖רֶב וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ דָּמ֥וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘ haš·šō·mê·a‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār wə·lō niz·hār wat·tā·ḇō·w ḥe·reḇ wat·tiq·qā·ḥê·hū dā·mōw ḇə·rō·šōw yih·yeh
verses.literal: Then if anyone hears . . . the sound of the horn but fails to heed the warning and the sword comes and takes him away his blood will be on his own head
verses.literalPt: Se aquele que ouvir o som da trombeta, não se der por avisado, e vier a espada, e o alcançar, o seu sangue será sobre a sua cabeça.

verses.original: אֵת֩ ק֨וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֤ר שָׁמַע֙ וְלֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר דָּמ֖וֹ בּ֣וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְה֥וּא נִזְהָ֖ר נַפְשׁ֥וֹ מִלֵּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār šā·ma‘ wə·lō niz·hār dā·mōw bōw yih·yeh wə·hū niz·hār nap̄·šōw mil·lêṭ
verses.literal: Since he heard the sound of the horn but failed to heed the warning his blood will be on his own head If he had heeded the warning he would have saved his life
verses.literalPt: Ele ouviu o som da trombeta, e não se deu por avisado, o seu sangue será sobre ele; mas o que se dá por avisado salvará a sua vida.

verses.original: וְ֠הַצֹּפֶה כִּֽי־ יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֜רֶב בָּאָ֗ה וְלֹֽא־ תָקַ֤ע בַּשּׁוֹפָר֙ וְהָעָ֣ם לֹֽא־ נִזְהָ֔ר וַתָּב֣וֹא חֶ֔רֶב וַתִּקַּ֥ח מֵהֶ֖ם נָ֑פֶשׁ ה֚וּא בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ נִלְקָ֔ח וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיַּֽד־ הַצֹּפֶ֥ה אֶדְרֹֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh kî- yir·’eh ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ bā·’āh wə·lō- ṯā·qa‘ baš·šō·w·p̄ār wə·hā·‘ām lō- niz·hār wat·tā·ḇō·w ḥe·reḇ wat·tiq·qaḥ mê·hem nā·p̄eš hū ba·‘ă·wō·nōw nil·qāḥ wə·ḏā·mōw mî·yaḏ- haṣ·ṣō·p̄eh ’eḏ·rōš
verses.literal: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and fails to blow the horn to warn the people and the sword comes and takes away . . . a life then that one will be taken away in his iniquity but I will hold the watchman accountable for his blood . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, se quando o atalaia vir que vem a espada, e não tocar a trombeta, e não for avisado o povo, e a espada vier, e levar uma vida dentre eles, este tal foi levado na sua iniqüidade, porém o seu sangue requererei da mão do atalaia.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִפִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ṣō·p̄eh nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·šā·ma‘·tā mip·pî dā·ḇār wə·hiz·har·tā ’ō·ṯām mim·men·nî
verses.literal: As for you O son of man I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel so hear the word from My mouth and give them the warning from Me
verses.literalPt: A ti, pois, ó filho do homem, te constituí por atalaia sobre a casa de Israel; tu, pois, ouvirás a palavra da minha boca, e lha anunciarás da minha parte.

verses.original: בְּאָמְרִ֣י לָרָשָׁ֗ע רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְלֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתָּ לְהַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֖ע מִדַּרְכּ֑וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיָּדְךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·mə·rî lā·rā·šā‘ rā·šā‘ mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ wə·lō ḏib·bar·tā lə·haz·hîr rā·šā‘ mid·dar·kōw hū rā·šā‘ ba·‘ă·wō·nōw yā·mūṯ wə·ḏā·mōw mî·yā·ḏə·ḵā ’ă·ḇaq·qêš
verses.literal: If I say to the wicked O wicked man you will surely die . . . but you do not speak out to dissuade him from his way then that wicked man will die in his iniquity yet I will hold you accountable for . . . his blood
verses.literalPt: Se eu disser ao ímpio: Ó ímpio, certamente morrerás; e tu não falares, para dissuadir ao ímpio do seu caminho, morrerá esse ímpio na sua iniqüidade, porém o seu sangue eu o requererei da tua mão.

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּה כִּֽי־ הִזְהַ֨רְתָּ רָשָׁ֤ע מִדַּרְכּוֹ֙ לָשׁ֣וּב מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְלֹא־ שָׁ֖ב מִדַּרְכּ֑וֹ ה֚וּא בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְאַתָּ֖ה נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh kî- hiz·har·tā rā·šā‘ mid·dar·kōw lā·šūḇ mim·men·nāh wə·lō- šāḇ mid·dar·kōw hū ba·‘ă·wō·nōw yā·mūṯ wə·’at·tāh nap̄·šə·ḵā hiṣ·ṣal·tā
verses.literal: But if you warn the wicked man to turn from his way and he does not turn from it he will die in his iniquity but you will have saved your life
verses.literalPt: Mas, se advertires o ímpio do seu caminho, para que dele se converta, e ele não se converter do seu caminho, ele morrerá na sua iniqüidade; mas tu livraste a tua alma.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֤ן אֲמַרְתֶּם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־ פְשָׁעֵ֥ינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵ֖ינוּ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּבָ֛ם אֲנַ֥חְנוּ נְמַקִּ֖ים וְאֵ֥יךְ נִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kên ’ă·mar·tem lê·mōr kî- p̄ə·šā·‘ê·nū wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯê·nū ‘ā·lê·nū ū·ḇām ’ă·naḥ·nū nə·maq·qîm wə·’êḵ niḥ·yeh
verses.literal: Now as for you son of man tell the house of Israel that this is what they have said . . . . . . Our transgressions and our sins are heavy upon us and we are wasting away because of them How can we live
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, filho do homem, dize à casa de Israel: Assim falais vós, dizendo: Visto que as nossas transgressões e os nossos pecados estão sobre nós, e nós desfalecemos neles, como viveremos então?

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם חַי־ אָ֣נִי׀ נְאֻ֣ם׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִם־ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הָרָשָׁ֔ע כִּ֣י אִם־ בְּשׁ֥וּב רָשָׁ֛ע מִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ וְחָיָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ שׁ֜וּבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֧ם הָרָעִ֛ים וְלָ֥מָּה תָמ֖וּתוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- ’eḥ·pōṣ bə·mō·wṯ hā·rā·šā‘ kî ’im- bə·šūḇ rā·šā‘ mid·dar·kōw wə·ḥā·yāh šū·ḇū šū·ḇū mid·dar·ḵê·ḵem hā·rā·‘îm wə·lām·māh ṯā·mū·ṯū bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Say to them As surely as I live declares the Lord GOD I take no pleasure in the death of the wicked but rather . . . that the wicked should turn from their ways and live Turn Turn from your evil ways For why should you die O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Dize-lhes: Vivo eu, diz o Senhor DEUS, que não tenho prazer na morte do ímpio, mas em que o ímpio se converta do seu caminho, e viva. Convertei-vos, convertei-vos dos vossos maus caminhos; pois, por que razão morrereis, ó casa de Israel?

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־ בְּנֵֽי־ עַמְּךָ֙ צִדְקַ֣ת הַצַּדִּ֗יק לֹ֤א תַצִּילֶ֙נּוּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וְרִשְׁעַ֤ת הָֽרָשָׁע֙ לֹֽא־ יִכָּ֣שֶׁל בָּ֔הּ בְּי֖וֹם שׁוּב֣וֹ מֵֽרִשְׁע֑וֹ וְצַדִּ֗יק לֹ֥א יוּכַ֛ל לִֽחְי֥וֹת בָּ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם חֲטֹאתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bə·nê- ‘am·mə·ḵā ṣiḏ·qaṯ haṣ·ṣad·dîq lō ṯaṣ·ṣî·len·nū bə·yō·wm piš·‘ōw wə·riš·‘aṯ hā·rā·šā‘ lō- yik·kā·šel bāh bə·yō·wm šū·ḇōw mê·riš·‘ōw wə·ṣad·dîq lō yū·ḵal liḥ·yō·wṯ bāh bə·yō·wm ḥă·ṭō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Therefore son of man say to your people . . . The righteousness of the righteous man will not deliver him in the day of his transgression neither will the wickedness of the wicked man cause him to stumble on the day he turns from his wickedness Nor will the righteous man be able to survive by his righteousness on the day he sins
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, filho do homem, dize aos filhos do teu povo: A justiça do justo não o livrará no dia da sua transgressão; e, quanto à impiedade do ímpio, não cairá por ela, no dia em que se converter da sua impiedade; nem o justo poderá viver pela sua justiça no dia em que pecar.

verses.original: בְּאָמְרִ֤י לַצַּדִּיק֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְהֽוּא־ בָטַ֥ח עַל־ צִדְקָת֖וֹ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל כָּל־ צִדְקָתוֹ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה וּבְעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֖ה בּ֥וֹ יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ā·mə·rî laṣ·ṣad·dîq ḥā·yōh yiḥ·yeh wə·hū- ḇā·ṭaḥ ‘al- ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel kāl- ṣiḏ·qå̄·ṯō lō ṯiz·zā·ḵar·nāh ū·ḇə·‘aw·lōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śāh bōw yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: If I tell the righteous man that he will surely live . . . but he then trusts in his righteousness and commits iniquity then none . . . of his righteous works will be remembered he will die because of the iniquity he has committed
verses.literalPt: Quando eu disser ao justo que certamente viverá, e ele, confiando na sua justiça, praticar a iniqüidade, não virão à memória todas as suas justiças, mas na sua iniqüidade, que pratica, ele morrerá.

verses.original: וּבְאָמְרִ֥י לָֽרָשָׁ֖ע מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וְשָׁב֙ מֵֽחַטָּאת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’ā·mə·rî lā·rā·šā‘ mō·wṯ tā·mūṯ wə·šāḇ mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: But if I tell the wicked man You will surely die . . . and he turns from his sin and does what is just and right
verses.literalPt: Quando eu também disser ao ímpio: Certamente morrerás; se ele se converter do seu pecado, e praticar juízo e justiça,

verses.original: חֲבֹ֨ל יָשִׁ֤יב רָשָׁע֙ גְּזֵלָ֣ה יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם בְּחֻקּ֤וֹת הַֽחַיִּים֙ הָלַ֔ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֣וֹת עָ֑וֶל חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḇōl yā·šîḇ rā·šā‘ gə·zê·lāh yə·šal·lêm bə·ḥuq·qō·wṯ ha·ḥay·yîm hā·laḵ lə·ḇil·tî ‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ā·wel ḥā·yōw yiḥ·yeh lō yā·mūṯ
verses.literal: if he restores a pledge makes restitution for what he has stolen and walks in the statutes of life without practicing iniquity then he will surely live . . . he will not die
verses.literalPt: Restituindo esse ímpio o penhor, indenizando o que furtou, andando nos estatutos da vida, e não praticando iniqüidade, certamente viverá, não morrerá.

verses.original: כָּל־ חַטָּאתוֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לֹ֥א תִזָּכַ֖רְנָה ל֑וֹ מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֛ה עָשָׂ֖ה חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ḥaṭ·ṭå̄·ṯō ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā lō ṯiz·zā·ḵar·nāh lōw miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ‘ā·śāh ḥā·yōw yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: None . . . of the sins he has committed will be held against him He has done what is just and right he will surely live . . .
verses.literalPt: De todos os seus pecados que cometeu não se terá memória contra ele; juízo e justiça fez, certamente viverá.

verses.original: וְאָמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְהֵ֖מָּה דַּרְכָּ֥ם לֹֽא־ יִתָּכֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū bə·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā lō yit·tā·ḵên de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy wə·hêm·māh dar·kām lō- yit·tā·ḵên
verses.literal: Yet your people . . . say The way of the Lord is not just But it is their way that is not just
verses.literalPt: Todavia os filhos do teu povo dizem: Não é justo o caminho do Senhor; mas o próprio caminho deles é que não é justo.

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־ צַדִּ֥יק מִצִּדְקָת֖וֹ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל וּמֵ֖ת בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šūḇ- ṣad·dîq miṣ·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh ‘ā·wel ū·mêṯ bā·hem
verses.literal: If a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits iniquity he will die for it
verses.literalPt: Desviando-se o justo da sua justiça, e praticando iniqüidade, morrerá nela.

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֤וּב רָשָׁע֙ מֵֽרִשְׁעָת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·šūḇ rā·šā‘ mê·riš·‘ā·ṯōw wə·‘ā·śāh miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh ‘ă·lê·hem hū yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: But if a wicked man turns from his wickedness and does what is just and right he will live because of this
verses.literalPt: E, convertendo-se o ímpio da sua impiedade, e praticando juízo e justiça, ele viverá por eles.

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י אִ֧ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֛יו אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·mar·tem lō yit·tā·ḵên de·reḵ ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’îš kiḏ·rā·ḵāw ’eš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rå̄·ʾēl p̄
verses.literal: Yet you say The way of the Lord is not just But I will judge each of you according to his ways O house of Israel
verses.literalPt: Todavia, vós dizeis: Não é justo o caminho do Senhor; julgar-vos-ei a cada um conforme os seus caminhos, ó casa de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בִּשְׁתֵּ֧י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה בָּעֲשִׂרִ֛י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לְגָלוּתֵ֑נוּ בָּא־ אֵלַ֨י הַפָּלִ֧יט מִירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לֵאמֹ֖ר הֻכְּתָ֥ה הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh bā·‘ă·śi·rî ba·ḥă·miš·šāh la·ḥō·ḏeš lə·ḡā·lū·ṯê·nū bā- ’ê·lay hap·pā·lîṭ mî·rū·šā·lim lê·mōr huk·kə·ṯāh hā·‘îr
verses.literal: In the twelfth . . . year of our exile on the fifth day of the tenth month a fugitive from Jerusalem came to me and reported The city has been taken
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, no ano duodécimo do nosso cativeiro, no décimo mês, aos cinco do mês, veio a mim um que tinha escapado de Jerusalém, dizendo: A cidade está ferida.

verses.original: וְיַד־ יְהוָה֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֵלַ֜י בָּעֶ֗רֶב לִפְנֵי֙ בּ֣וֹא הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח אֶת־ פִּ֔י עַד־ בּ֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּפָּ֣תַח פִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱלַ֖מְתִּי עֽוֹד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·yaḏ- Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh ’ê·lay bā·‘e·reḇ lip̄·nê bō·w hap·pā·lîṭ way·yip̄·taḥ ’eṯ- pî ‘aḏ- bō·w ’ê·lay bab·bō·qer way·yip·pā·ṯaḥ pî wə·lō ne·’ĕ·lam·tî ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: Now the evening before the fugitive arrived the hand of the LORD was upon me and He opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning So my mouth was opened and I was no longer mute
verses.literalPt: Ora, a mão do SENHOR estivera sobre mim pela tarde, antes que viesse o que tinha escapado; e ele abrira a minha boca antes que esse homem viesse ter comigo pela manhã; e abriu-se a minha boca, e não fiquei mais calado.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם יֹ֠שְׁבֵי הֶחֳרָב֨וֹת הָאֵ֜לֶּה עַל־ אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹמְרִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶחָד֙ הָיָ֣ה אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיִּירַ֖שׁ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֔ים לָ֛נוּ נִתְּנָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמוֹרָשָֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām yō·šə·ḇê he·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh ‘al- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ō·mə·rîm lê·mōr ’e·ḥāḏ hā·yāh ’aḇ·rā·hām way·yî·raš ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wa·’ă·naḥ·nū rab·bîm lā·nū nit·tə·nāh hā·’ā·reṣ lə·mō·w·rā·šāh
verses.literal: Son of man those living in the ruins in the land of Israel are saying . . . Abraham was only one man yet he possessed the land But we are many surely the land has been given to us as a possession
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, os moradores destes lugares desertos da terra de Israel falam, dizendo: Abraão era um só, e possuiu esta terra; mas nós somos muitos, esta terra nos foi dada em possessão.

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה עַל־ הַדָּ֧ם׀ תֹּאכֵ֛לוּ וְעֵינֵכֶ֛ם תִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶל־ גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ם וְדָ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֑כוּ וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ‘al- had·dām tō·ḵê·lū wə·‘ê·nê·ḵem tiś·’ū ’el- gil·lū·lê·ḵem wə·ḏām tiš·pō·ḵū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tî·rā·šū
verses.literal: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD . . . says You eat meat with the blood in it lift up your eyes to your idols and shed blood Should you then possess the land
verses.literalPt: Dize-lhes portanto: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Comeis a carne com o sangue, e levantais os vossos olhos para os vossos ídolos, e derramais o sangue! Porventura possuireis a terra?

verses.original: עֲמַדְתֶּ֤ם עַֽל־ חַרְבְּכֶם֙ עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ן תּוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־ אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּאתֶ֑ם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·maḏ·tem ‘al- ḥar·bə·ḵem ‘ă·śî·ṯen tō·w·‘ê·ḇāh wə·’îš ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū ṭim·mê·ṯem wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tî·rā·šū
verses.literal: You have relied on your swords you have committed detestable acts and each of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife Should you then possess the land
verses.literalPt: Vós vos estribais sobre a vossa espada, cometeis abominação, e cada um contamina a mulher do seu próximo! E possuireis a terra?

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ תֹאמַ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֮ חַי־ אָנִי֒ אִם־ לֹ֞א אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֶּֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַחַיָּ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יו לְאָכְל֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר בַּמְּצָד֥וֹת וּבַמְּעָר֖וֹת בַּדֶּ֥בֶר יָמֽוּתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ṯō·mar ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ḥay- ’ā·nî ’im- lō ’ă·šer be·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ ba·ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū wa·’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh la·ḥay·yāh nə·ṯat·tîw lə·’ā·ḵə·lōw wa·’ă·šer bam·mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ ū·ḇam·mə·‘ā·rō·wṯ bad·de·ḇer yā·mū·ṯū
verses.literal: Tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says As surely as I . . . . . . live those in the ruins will fall by the sword those in the open field . . . I will give to be devoured by wild animals and those in the strongholds and caves will die by plague
verses.literalPt: Assim lhes dirás: Assim disse o Senhor DEUS: Vivo eu, que os que estiverem em lugares desertos, cairão à espada, e o que estiver em campo aberto o entregarei às feras, para que o devorem, e os que estiverem em lugares fortes e em cavernas morrerão de peste.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְנִשְׁבַּ֖ת גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑הּ וְשָֽׁמְמ֛וּ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֵ֥ין עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ū·mə·šam·māh wə·niš·baṯ gə·’ō·wn ‘uz·zāh wə·šā·mə·mū hā·rê yiś·rā·’êl mê·’ên ‘ō·w·ḇêr
verses.literal: I will make the land a desolate waste and the pride of her strength will come to an end The mountains of Israel will become desolate so that no one will pass through
verses.literalPt: E tornarei a terra em desolação e espanto e cessará a soberba do seu poder; e os montes de Israel ficarão tão desolados que ninguém passará por eles.

verses.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֶת־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh bə·ṯit·tî ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ šə·mā·māh ū·mə·šam·māh ‘al kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Then they will know that I am the LORD when I have made the land a desolate waste because of all the abominations they have committed
verses.literalPt: Então saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, quando eu tornar a terra em desolação e espanto, por causa de todas as abominações que cometeram.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ הַנִּדְבָּרִ֤ים בְּךָ֙ אֵ֣צֶל הַקִּיר֔וֹת וּבְפִתְחֵ֖י הַבָּתִּ֑ים וְדִבֶּר־ חַ֣ד אֶת־ אַחַ֗ד אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֹּֽאוּ־ נָ֣א וְשִׁמְע֔וּ מָ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר הַיּוֹצֵ֖א מֵאֵ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ḇen- ’ā·ḏām bə·nê ‘am·mə·ḵā han·niḏ·bā·rîm bə·ḵā ’ê·ṣel haq·qî·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·p̄iṯ·ḥê hab·bāt·tîm wə·ḏib·ber- ḥaḏ ’eṯ- ’a·ḥaḏ ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw lê·mōr bō·’ū- nā wə·šim·‘ū māh had·dā·ḇār hay·yō·w·ṣê mê·’êṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: As for you son of man your people . . . are talking about you near the city walls and in the doorways of their houses One . . . speaks to another each saying to his brother Come . . . and hear the message that has come from the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quanto a ti, ó filho do homem, os filhos do teu povo falam de ti junto às paredes e nas portas das casas; e fala um com o outro, cada um a seu irmão, dizendo: Vinde, peço-vos, e ouvi qual seja a palavra que procede do SENHOR.

verses.original: וְיָב֣וֹאוּ אֵ֠לֶיךָ כִּמְבוֹא־ עָ֞ם וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ עַמִּ֔י וְשָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ וְאוֹתָ֖ם לֹ֣א יַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־ עֲגָבִ֤ים בְּפִיהֶם֙ הֵ֣מָּה עֹשִׂ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י בִצְעָ֖ם לִבָּ֥ם הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḇō·w·’ū ’ê·le·ḵā kim·ḇō·w- ‘ām wə·yê·šə·ḇū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ‘am·mî wə·šā·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- də·ḇā·re·ḵā wə·’ō·w·ṯām lō ya·‘ă·śū kî- ‘ă·ḡā·ḇîm bə·p̄î·hem hêm·māh ‘ō·śîm ’a·ḥă·rê ḇiṣ·‘ām lib·bām hō·lêḵ
verses.literal: So My people come to you as usual . . . sit before you and hear your words but they do not put them into practice Although they express . . . love with their mouths their hearts pursue dishonest gain
verses.literalPt: E eles vêm a ti, como o povo costumava vir, e se assentam diante de ti, como meu povo, e ouvem as tuas palavras, mas não as põem por obra; pois lisonjeiam com a sua boca, mas o seu coração segue a sua avareza.

verses.original: וְהִנְּךָ֤ לָהֶם֙ כְּשִׁ֣יר עֲגָבִ֔ים יְפֵ֥ה ק֖וֹל וּמֵטִ֣ב נַגֵּ֑ן וְשָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־ דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ וְעֹשִׂ֥ים אֵינָ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nə·ḵā lā·hem kə·šîr ‘ă·ḡā·ḇîm yə·p̄êh qō·wl ū·mê·ṭiḇ nag·gên wə·šā·mə·‘ū ’eṯ- də·ḇā·re·ḵā wə·‘ō·śîm ’ê·nām ’ō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Indeed, you are to them like a singer of love songs with a beautiful voice who skillfully plays an instrument They hear your words but do not put them into practice
verses.literalPt: E eis que tu és para eles como uma canção de amores, de quem tem voz suave, e que bem tange; porque ouvem as tuas palavras, mas não as põem por obra.

verses.original: וּבְבֹאָ֑הּ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ḇō·’āh hin·nêh ḇā·’āh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî nā·ḇî hā·yāh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: So when it comes to pass and surely it will come then they will know that a prophet has been among them
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando vier isto (eis que está para vir), então saberão que houve no meio deles um profeta.
